rule.change_our_mind: We would change the recommendation if at least 3 dated, sourced demand signals and 1 competitor with a verified public price were found, with no blocking compliance flag and a plan that fits the founder's budget and time.

definitions.demand_signal: A SUPPORTED claim, backed by a fetched source, of one of: a dated forum/community post describing the problem; an existing paid product with a public pricing page; a sourced trend.
definitions.paying_competitor: A competitor whose price was read from its own fetched page and verified by the claim checker.
definitions.direct_competitor: Same buyer, same job, same channel as the founder's idea.
definitions.blocking_compliance_flag: The idea falls in an excluded category (physical goods, financial/crypto, health or legal advice) or needs a licence the founder does not have.

rule.brief_idea: A pack of payment-reminder email templates and an invoicing checklist for new freelancers
rule.counting: distinct (source_url, type) SUPPORTED claims of types demand_signal, paying_competitor, trend, checked by a different model family
